t: Designing an AI-Ready Web: From NavGraph to Semantic Cache
s: The article proposes designing the web for AI comprehension by structuring content hierarchically, akin to an 'External Hippocampus', moving beyond human-centric navigation to create a 'NavGraph' for intelligent agents.
sub: NavGraph: A semantically optimized website blueprint for AI.
Responsive Design parallel for AI readiness, lacking a physical forcing function.
Accessibility Tree as the AI's true viewport for navigation.
Evolution of web navigation: from feeds to taxonomy, catalogs, and client-side hydration.
